statement: At the pinned Linux v6.11 tag, f_hid handles HID GET_REPORT with a zero-filled reply. At v6.12, the userspace GET_REPORT response ioctl is present, and it remains present at v7.3. This is a kernel-source comparison, not a demonstration of compatible controller feature-report behavior.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Host f_hid versions only; original report payloads, consumer binding and physical devices were not tested.
